svg.text: W34 THE JOIN - error chain unites here
ONE unbroken error wire, olive and thicker than the rest: error in > Tick(t0) > TCP Write >
TCP Read > Tick(t1) > Open > Set File Position > Write to Text File > Close File > error out.
The two Tick.vi nodes bracket ONLY the two TCP nodes - that is why elapsed ms measures the
query and nothing else. Wire 34 (Tick t1 error out > Open) is the join that forces the four file
nodes to run AFTER the timing. Without it LabVIEW could interleave them and the number lies.
Hollow squares = terminals left deliberately unwired. A dot on a wire = a BRANCH: one source,
two sinks, same value copied - it is not a split. Colours: pink string, orange DBL, blue I32,
grey refnum (TCP + file), green file path, olive error cluster.
BOTTOM BAND - TRACE ROW + FILE CHAIN
